Title: Growth Inhibitors of Neisseria gonorrhoeae
Description: The authors curated a dataset of 282 compounds from ChEMBL, of which 160 (56.7%) were labeled as active N. gonorrhoeae inhibitor compounds. They used this dataset to build a naïve Bayesian model and used it to screen a commercial library. With this method, they identified and validated two hits. We have used the dataset to build a model using LazyQSAR with CheMeleon Embeddings as molecular descriptors, with AUROC of 0.86 (5-fold crossvalidation).
Interpretation: Probability of activity for the inhibition of the pathogen N. gonorrhoeae
